lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地碾过碎石。
lines.en: I hop across the gravel, one heavy bound at a time.
The ground shudders when I land.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一蹬，就飞出老远。
lines.en: One push of my hind legs and I fly far.
I creep along the cracks in the rock.
The pads on my toes grip firmly.

lines.zh: 我走得摇摇晃晃，像块肉。
lines.en: I waddle along like a lump of flesh.

lines.zh: 我一跳，下界的碎石就四散。
lines.en: One hop and nether rubble scatters.

lines.zh: 我挤过窄缝，肚子先过去。
lines.en: I squeeze through a gap belly first.

lines.zh: 火光把我的皮照得发亮。
lines.en: Firelight makes my hide glisten.
I hop onto a low rock and look around.
This patch is one I come to often.

lines.zh: 我蹲伏着往前，肚子擦着地。
lines.en: I crouch forward, belly brushing the ground.
I puff my throat sac and let it deflate slowly.
I squat motionless like a stone.

lines.zh: 我一只眼盯着火，一只盯着路。
lines.en: One eye on the fire, one on the path.

lines.zh: 热风把我的皮吹得发干。
lines.en: The hot wind dries my skin.
My eyes do not blink at all.
I wait for something to fly past.
My forelegs prop me up; my hind legs are tucked.

lines.zh: 皮肤上有一层薄薄的水光。
lines.en: A thin sheen of moisture covers my skin.
I am in no hurry. I never am.
Lava bubbles somewhere off in the distance.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴在地上散热。
lines.en: I press my belly down to shed heat.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得只有火声。
lines.en: The only sound here is fire.
I shake the ash off my hide.

lines.zh: 我在等一只飞虫走错路。
lines.en: I wait for a bug to take a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 你踩到我蹲的那块石头了。
lines.en: You stepped on the stone I was crouching on.
I am looking at you. You know it.

lines.zh: 我的嘴比我的身体更宽。
lines.en: My mouth is wider than my body would suggest.

lines.zh: 你身上有一股奇怪的味道。
lines.en: You carry a strange smell.

lines.zh: 我不常动，但动起来很快。
lines.en: I seldom move, but I move fast.

lines.zh: 你听见我喉咙里的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that sound in my throat?
This patch belongs to me.
I lift a foreleg and set it down again.

lines.zh: 你在打量我，我也在打量你的下界疣。
lines.en: You study me, and I study your nether wart.
My hide is not for touching.
The air here does not suit you.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我们还能说话。
lines.en: Take one step back and we can still talk.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，是因为这样起跳更快。
lines.en: I crouch because it makes my leap quicker.

lines.zh: 你在发抖，是热的还是怕的？
lines.en: You are trembling — from heat, or fear?
I turn my head toward you, slowly.

lines.zh: 你把火把举到我眼前，太近了。
lines.en: You hold the torch right before my eyes; too close.

lines.zh: 我们的影子都拉得很长。
lines.en: Both our shadows stretch long.

lines.zh: 你要扔东西过来吗？我等着。
lines.en: Are you going to throw something? I am waiting.

lines.zh: 我鼓起的喉囊瘪了下去。
lines.en: My swollen throat sac deflates.
A split opens in my hide.
I hop back a step.

lines.zh: 这一声，连我自己都吓到。
lines.en: That cry startled even me.
I breathe heavily, my throat rattling.
Blood runs down mixed with slime.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，护住肚子。
lines.en: I flatten down and guard my belly.
The pain turns my legs to jelly.

lines.zh: 我又鼓起了喉咙，是气的。
lines.en: My throat swells again — with anger.
That hurt. Do not do it again.

lines.zh: 你手里那只小飞虫，别放飞。
lines.en: That little flying bug in your hand — don't let it go.
Does it hop? I like that.
Hold it still. Do not wave it about.
My tongue goes out and misses.
A little closer and I can snap it up.
That smell will not let me sit still.
Move aside; do not stand in the way.
I swallow loudly.
I shuffle over slowly; watch.

lines.zh: 一次就够，我胃口不算大。
lines.en: One will do; my appetite is modest.

lines.zh: 下界的蛙，皮厚得像湿皮革。
lines.en: A Nether frog's hide feels like wet leather.
The shove slid me half a step.
My hide is slick and wet.
Do not step on my toes.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的喉咙鼓起来。
lines.en: That made my throat swell up.
I lean on your leg; I am heavy.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，都有点热。
lines.en: Crowded together, we both run hot.
Back up; I cannot turn around here.
I grunt and push forward.

lines.zh: 这地方容不下两个大家伙。
lines.en: This spot will not hold two big bodies.
I puff my throat and call for you.
The low vibration carries a long way.

lines.zh: 我们一起蹲在这块岩上。
lines.en: We squat together on this rock.
Did you catch my call?
Eggs in water — that is the safe way.
You jump first; I will follow.

lines.zh: 我们的皮贴在一起，很凉。
lines.en: Our hides touch, and it is cool.
This pool is wide enough.
I wait for your echo.
Call once more. Just once.
One curl of my tongue and it is gone.

lines.zh: 金子太烫，我在嘴里翻了两次。
lines.en: The gold is too hot; I flip it twice in my mouth.
This smells a bit scorched.
I pin it under my toes.
It sticks a little going down.
I do not chew; I swallow whole.

lines.zh: 这东西在我嘴里还在动。
lines.en: This thing is still moving in my mouth.
Even what falls in the ash, I will take.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，免得压碎它。
lines.en: I shuffle over so as not to crush it.
When done, I lick my lips.
You stepped into my range.
I saw your foot move.
I gather my hind legs under me.
This leap I will not hold back.
You look lighter than you seem.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张开的时候，别靠近。
lines.en: When my mouth opens, do not come close.
You are between me and the water.

lines.zh: 你退到熔岩边上，没路了。
lines.en: You back to the lava's edge and run out of road.
Step back, or be swallowed.

lines.zh: 热风里混着你血的味道。
lines.en: Your blood is mixed into the smell of the hot wind.
A target that size — easy.
My bullfrog throat sac swells.

lines.zh: 下界的蛙，舌头比身体长。
lines.en: A Nether frog's tongue is longer than its body.
Do not run; it only excites me.

lines.zh: 这一带的火光照得清楚。
lines.en: The firelight here makes things clear.
You carry heat; I have chosen you.
I hold perfectly still, only waiting.
Your steps are coming closer.
I am judging the length of this leap.
I curl my toes tight around the blackstone.
When you turn, I move.
I crouch even lower.
My shadow on the ground has not moved.
I hear you swallow.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙一鼓，下界都听见。
lines.en: My throat swells, and the Nether hears.
This rock will not stop me.
The firelight will hide my movement.
My throat swells again.

lines.zh: 你有三次机会，现在用掉一次了。
lines.en: You get three chances; that was one.
Do not watch my eyes; watch my legs.

lines.zh: 你已经在我的起跳点上了。
lines.en: You are already at my launch point.

lines.zh: 下界的牛蛙，躲在岩缝里。
lines.en: The Nether bullfrog hides in the rock.

lines.zh: 我闻到了你出汗的味道。
lines.en: I smell your sweat.
I have held this breath long enough.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，整个身子压下来。
lines.en: I lunge and bring my whole bulk down.
My tongue snaps out and wraps around.

lines.zh: 我的重量才是最厉害的。
lines.en: My weight is the real weapon.
That shove flips you over.

lines.zh: 下界的蛙，嗓子比牛还粗。
lines.en: A Nether frog with a voice deeper than a cow's.
I land, and you are underneath.
My mouth opens wider than your head.
I press down on your arm.

lines.zh: 热气从我的皮上冒出来。
lines.en: Heat rises off my hide.

lines.zh: 你挣扎的时候我也在滑。
lines.en: I slide too while you struggle.
I put too much into that one.

lines.zh: 你被我的舌头抽了一下。
lines.en: My tongue lashed you once.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，把你压在下面。
lines.en: I roll and pin you beneath me.
Again — I am not full yet.
My foreleg presses on your chest.

lines.zh: 这地方的地面太硬，反弹了。
lines.en: The ground here is hard and bounced me.
I squeeze out from a crack in the rock.

lines.zh: 我蹲在熔岩边的石头上。
lines.en: I squat on a stone beside the lava.

lines.zh: 先是一声低鸣，然后是我。
lines.en: First a low croak, then me.

lines.zh: 热气把我从暗处推出来。
lines.en: The heat pushes me out of the dark.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，震起一层灰。
lines.en: I land and a layer of ash puffs up.

lines.zh: 我从下界岩的缝里探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head out of a netherrack crack.
Ash still clings to my hide.
I slowly inflate my throat sac.
Firelight picks out my back.
I drop down from above, loudly.
You can hear me breathing.
There is a new smell on this ground.
I square myself up and look at you.

lines.zh: 我不算大，只是看起来大。
lines.en: I am not that big — I only look it.
I walk out of the steam.

lines.zh: 脚趾先落地，然后才是肚子。
lines.en: Toes land first, then the belly.
It is cooler here than I expected.

lines.zh: 我鼓了一次喉囊，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I puff my throat once as a greeting.
Fire blisters my hide.
I landed too hard and my gut jolted.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我蹬不动腿。
lines.en: Water pours into my mouth and my legs will not kick.
Blast dust coats my whole body.
Something punched through my hide.

lines.zh: 冰凉的咒语让我的皮收紧了。
lines.en: The cold spell tightens my hide.

lines.zh: 我吞了几口灰，压不住饿。
lines.en: I swallow a few mouthfuls of ash, but the hunger stays.
Lightning strikes and my whole body clenches.

lines.zh: 这里没有岩壁，我的腿蹬空了。
lines.en: There is no rock wall here; my legs kick at nothing.
